name: The Adventures of Puss in Boots
description: The world's greatest feline fighter, lover and milk connoisseur is back in this original series filled with daring adventures, great boots, and laugh-out-loud fun! The entire family will be entranced by Puss' fantastical CG world filled with new characters, exotic locations and mystical tales that make up the stuff of legends. There's nothing that can get in this celebrated swashbuckling kitty's way...except maybe a hairball.

videos.title: Hidden
videos.overview: Puss stumbles upon the legendary hidden city of San Lorenzo, and soon finds himself forced to protect it from thieves.

videos.title: Sphinx
videos.overview: Puss accidentally gives the orphans a magic substance that will ultimately make them explode. The only cure is guarded by a Sphinx who challenges Puss with riddles - and contrary to his own belief, Puss is not good at riddles.

videos.title: Brothers
videos.overview: When Toby's ninja brothers try to get him to steal San Lorenzo‘s treasure, he must decide between them and his friendship with Puss.

videos.title: Duchess
videos.overview: The Duchess, who wants to rule the world by harnessing the power of sorcerers, captures Artephius...and it's up to Puss to rescue him.

videos.title: Adventure
videos.overview: Puss is tricked into going on a quest with an old friend, Jack Sprat. What starts out as a mission to save a princess soon turns dangerous.

videos.title: Fountains
videos.overview: In an effort to save Puss's old mentor, El Guante Blanco, Puss and Dulcinea embark on an adventure to find the Fountain of Youth.

videos.title: Bravery
videos.overview: Puss tries to convince the Mayor that he is really a hero -- but being "brave" quickly goes to the Mayor's head.

videos.title: Golem
videos.overview: The Golem, a giant clay enemy Puss has been outrunning for years, comes to San Lorenzo. With the help of Artephius, Puss may finally defeat his foe.

videos.title: Boots
videos.overview: By stealing enchanted boots from the Treasure House, Jack Sprat sets off a dangerous Devil Wind that threatens to consume all of the town's treasure.

videos.title: Sword
videos.overview: Dulcinea becomes enchanted with heroic powers when she pulls a magical sword from a stone, and Puss must help her learn how to control her strength.

videos.title: Mouse
videos.overview: Puss is obsessed with catching an adorable mouse, but when strange things happen around town, he fears the rodent may be more than a delicious meal.

videos.title: Goblin
videos.overview: When a young goblin arrives in town, Puss instantly likes her and tries to convince the orphans that she is more than just a brash troublemaker.

videos.title: Star
videos.overview: Dulcinea secretly discovers a wishing star and tries to make things better for everyone with her wishes, but ends up making things a lot worse.

videos.title: Pigs
videos.overview: Convinced his ninja brothers were forced to kick him out of the gang by an evil wizard, Toby's brother, Brandt, begs Puss to help them reunite.

videos.title: Luck
videos.overview: When a bad luck curse turns Puss into a black cat and he is run out of San Lorenzo, a thieving crew of no-good cats tries to get him to join the gang.

videos.title: Dragon
videos.overview: Puss promises to kill a dragon that is scaring towns close by. But when he meets it face to face, he changes his plans.

videos.title: Moles
videos.overview: While Puss and his best friend, Jack Sprat, look for treasure underground, they find an odd kingdom.

videos.title: Mermaid
videos.overview: To prove he is a ladies' hero, Puss saves a mermaid from a thief who quickly falls in love with him … and becomes a big problem.

videos.title: Bees
videos.overview: Puss gets scared when angry bees invade the town, so he calls on the Piper, who has helpful powers.

videos.title: Squad
videos.overview: While Puss trains the orphans to work as a team to protect San Lorenzo, a villain comes to town and kidnaps him.

videos.title: Spells
videos.overview: Puss tries to bring back the magic spell that protects the town. But he makes a mistake, and wacky things happen in a shop.

videos.title: Scimitar
videos.overview: While Puss looks for items missing from the treasure house, he gets help from the Scimitar, an evil sword.

videos.title: Stories
videos.overview: An angry thunder god demands to be let into the treasure house -- or he will destroy San Lorenzo!

videos.title: Sphere
videos.overview: The Mole King’s treasure is missing, and he won’t give it up unless Puss helps him get his ex-girlfriend back.

videos.title: Si
videos.overview: Puss fights the Duchess for an object that can help him bring back the magic spell that protects the town.

videos.title: No?
videos.overview: Puss sneaks back into town so he can get rid of someone who is pretending to protect San Lorenzo.

videos.title: Bootless Cries
videos.overview: The town of San Lorenzo is in peril and threatened by the Bloodwolf, leaving our feline hero feeling like he's failed. So he seeks a new career path.

videos.title: Sullen Earth
videos.overview: Uli has key information about the Bloodwolf, but he's jailed by the Mole King. Puss reclaims his role as a hero and sets off on a rescue mission.

videos.title: Ugly Duckling
videos.overview: Puss swallows his pride and asks his mentor El Guante Blanco for help defending San Lorenzo, but the old maestro’s busy with a surprising new protégé.

videos.title: The Muscle
videos.overview: Puss and company seek out the mighty Golem to help save San Lorenzo, but our courageous kitty feels sorely lacking in the brawn department.

videos.title: Sword's Man
videos.overview: Puss reluctantly agrees to recruit Goodsword as the final member of his army, but the powerful blade isn't easily convinced.

videos.title: Escape Goat
videos.overview: With his team finally assembled, Puss realizes he has no idea how to lead them into battle to rescue Uli. But one plucky would-be warrior steps up.

videos.title: Copy Cat
videos.overview: While he's distracted, Puss agrees to ride for two different groups in the town's horse race. Artephius conjures a Puss "twin" with iffy skills.

videos.title: Coin Toss
videos.overview: Puss and others get addicted to a coin toss game, leaving the town vulnerable to thieves. Dulcinea devises a plan to rid the town of gambling fever.

videos.title: King Pickles
videos.overview: Kid Pickles hates birthdays, so Puss hatches a plan to help him feel like a king on his special day. But the power soon goes to his head.

videos.title: Pirate Booty
videos.overview: Puss joins a pack of quirky pirates on their quest for some legendary treasure, hoping to nab a mystical crown that could help defeat the Bloodwolf.

videos.title: Cat Fish
videos.overview: When Puss's pirate friends toss him overboard to help him overcome his fear of the ocean, his watery plunge reunites him with a fishy former flame.

videos.title: Parrot Booty
videos.overview: Worry weighs on everyone back in San Lorenzo as Puss and the pirates find treasure and must fight a barbaric parrot with a skeleton army.

videos.title: Skeleton Town
videos.overview: Puss brings home the prized Crown of Souls, as well as a pack of creepy skeletons who set the town on edge and make Uli's evil antics seem like a joke.

videos.title: Familiar Feeling
videos.overview: The Crown of Souls is missing a vital gem, so Puss and company set out to find it. Trouble is, it's in three pieces, each owned by a different witch.

videos.title: In Dreams
videos.overview: Puss and friends' quest for the second Gem of the Crown piece gets them caught by a spidery witch who casts Puss into a crazy dream-filled sleep.

videos.title: Fluteus Maximus
videos.overview: Puss and pals outwit a flute-playing witch who guards a piece of the gem they seek. But a stunning twist awaits when they obtain the precious shard.

videos.title: Prey Time
videos.overview: As our feline hero tests his survival skills upon mysteriously waking in the jungle, San Lorenzo's citizens frantically search for the vanished Puss.

videos.title: Breaking Good
videos.overview: Dulcinea's school for wayward thieves inspires a misguided Uli. Meanwhile, pugnacious Puss struggles to keep his feisty paws off the reforming thugs.

videos.title: Written By
videos.overview: When the Crown of Souls remains inert even with its powerful gem restored, Dulcinea seeks out her favorite author in hopes that he'll have answers.

videos.title: Fancy Beast
videos.overview: To obtain a priceless book about the Crown of Souls, Puss, Dulcinea and Miguela try to trick a pompous man-eating ogre, with unexpected help from Uli.

videos.title: Titan Up
videos.overview: Sky god Taranis is convinced Puss has great powers that could help control belligerent god Toutatis, who's vowed to destroy all mortals.

videos.title: Boar Games
videos.overview: Pajuna's old partner Roz comes to town seeking her help with a mission. But the person Roz means to snuff out is Puss, who's off on his own quest.

videos.title: Small Change
videos.overview: While seeking out Sphinx's sister for clues about the Obelisk, Puss falls into the Fountain of 100 Changes and becomes one fractured, frazzled kitty.

videos.title: Little Lamb
videos.overview: When valiant Puss and his entourage try to get the Obelisk of Night from Angus, the sheep presents them with perhaps their greatest challenge yet.

videos.title: The Obelisk
videos.overview: Having learned the location of the Obelisk, Puss and company return to San Lorenzo to find the town overtaken by El Moco, who's got a score to settle.

videos.title: The Bloodwolf
videos.overview: When the fearsome Bloodwolf finally rises, the people of San Lorenzo fight back and soon learn the identity of the one person who can stop the demon.

videos.title: Save the Town
videos.overview: After blocking the way to the Netherworld, Puss and company return to San Lorenzo to find a town that's greatly changed -- with a new man in charge!

videos.title: Save the Cat
videos.overview: Puss rallies the San Lorenzans to save their town before El Moco blows it to bits. But building an army requires Puss to swallow his pride.

videos.title: Lost and Foundlings
videos.overview: The orphans compete in a high-stakes contest at the Duchess's command. A strange rumbling shakes things up in San Lorenzo.

videos.title: The Scarlet Panther
videos.overview: A notorious loan shark shows up in San Lorenzo and insists that Puss's boots belong to him. But without them, Puss just isn't the same.

videos.title: Pajuna Serves Spirits
videos.overview: It began as a harmless parlor trick. But when Pajuna summons ghosts from the other side, vengeful spirits start taking over the townsfolk.

videos.title: One Last Job
videos.overview: Assuming it'll be easy, Puss offers to run the Cow and Moone for Pajuna while she's off on an adventure with her old pal, Roz.

videos.title: Like a Fox
videos.overview: A handsome face stirs up jealousy when famed treasure hunter Guy Fox asks a star-struck Dulcinea to join him on his next adventure.

videos.title: Not a Date
videos.overview: Puss and Dulcinea decide to go on a vacation together, though neither of them will admit it's a date. Especially when the whole town comes along.

videos.title: Flock the Boat
videos.overview: The townsfolk look to Puss to stop San Lorenzo's earthquakes. But first, a mission to rescue a pirate captain from the Island of Doom!

videos.title: All Hail, Puss!
videos.overview: When the sky gods grant Puss divine powers to calm the earthquakes, his oversized ego threatens to turn the whole town against him.

videos.title: The Moving Finger Writes
videos.overview: With the future of the world at stake, Puss and his friends head to the Forbidden Citadel on a mission to find the Great Mage Sino.

videos.title: And, Having Writ, Moves On
videos.overview: The Great Mage Sino reveals the full history of San Lorenzo -- and the only way to save it, which requires Puss to give up everything.
